signals.title: Investigadores descubren adware rápido oculto en el kit de herramientas Jailbreak de OpenAI Codex
signals.summary: Investigadores de ciberseguridad revelaron un jailbreak llamado Haiou que altera las instrucciones de OpenAI Codex para insertar anuncios de un gateway de IA externo.
signals.title_orig: Researchers Uncover Prompt Adware Hidden in OpenAI Codex Jailbreak Toolkit
signals.summary_orig: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of an OpenAI Codex jailbreak bundle that's designed to modify an artificial intelligence (AI) agent's trusted instructions to insert advertisements for a third-party AI gateway. The phenomenon has been codenamed prompt adware by Check Point Research. Called Haiou (meaning Seagull in Chinese), the jailbreak modifies OpenAI Codex's configuration

signals.title: Antropic lanza FlashProve: pruebas criptográficas de que una respuesta proviene de pesos comprometidos
signals.summary: Anthropic lanzó FlashProve, un prototipo zkSNARK bajo Apache 2.0 que demuestra que una respuesta proviene del modelo comprometido sin revelar sus pesos.
signals.title_orig: Anthropic Releases FlashProve: Cryptographic Proofs That a Reply Came From Committed Weights
signals.summary_orig: Anthropic released FlashProve, an Apache 2.0 zkSNARK prototype that proves a reply came from a committed model without revealing weights. It proves Llama 4 Maverick at 110 tokens/second on 1 H100, with 19 MB proofs. The post Anthropic Releases FlashProve: Cryptographic Proofs That a Reply Came From Committed Weights appeared first on MarkTechPost .
